node.title: Re: Find.pm can't
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Use of uninitialized value $cwd in concatenation (.) or string at /usr/share/perl5/File/Find.pm line 283. Can't cd to : No such file or directory

That's strange... in [https://perl5.git.perl.org/perl.git/blob/v5.26.2:/ext/File-Find/lib/File/Find.pm#l282|the source], I don't see $cwd getting set by anything other than [doc://Cwd]'s getcwd (in your case at least). Just as a test, try adding use Cwd; to your code, and right before you call find, add print "cwd: ",getcwd()||$!,"\n"; to see if there's an obvious reason getcwd is failing.
